markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (59%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (34%) remains in the 90% prediction set with 7% invasive risk [F1] on this simulated frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 59%, InSitu 34%, Invasive 7%, Benign 0% | Normal favored; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% dataset coverage target) | Cannot separate Normal from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, OOD percentile 1.0 (12/12 regions) [F6] | Input passes quality checks |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 40% match (2/5 Normal, 2/5 InSitu, 1/5 Invasive) [F5] | Split between Normal and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-0.78) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.57) supports non-invasive call [F3]; 20/20 spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest pro-invasive score (+0.49) [F4], but 3/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (-0.33) fits InSitu competitor; 12/20 spot-check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.31), but weak with 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Not shown faithful (95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules, necrosis, and mitoses scores.

## Could be wrong if
- Lower regions (5, 8–11) harbor in situ carcinoma, matching top neighbor BACH_0155 (InSitu) or requiring drafted deeper levels.
- Focal invasion exists in region 8 (91% risk), or near-threshold margins (99%–100%) are involved despite clear call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 10, 4**: Highest heatmap risk (91%, 15%, 9%); check region 8 for pleomorphism, invasion, and margins.
2. **Regions 5, 9, 11**: Check for in situ lesion where duct-confined and unreliable necrosis peak; consider deeper levels.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Verify benign stroma/fat and unreliable normal lobule scores driving the Normal call.
